arxiv-2002-07572.title: Effective containment explains sub-exponential growth in confirmed cases of recent COVID-19 outbreak in Mainland China
arxiv-2002-07572.creator: Benjamin F. Maier, Dirk Brockmann
arxiv-2002-07572.description: Abstract The recent outbreak of COVID-19 in Mainland China is characterized by a distinctive algebraic, sub-exponential increase of confirmed cases with time during the early phase of the epidemic, contrasting an initial exponential growth expected for an unconstrained outbreak with sufficiently large reproduction rate.

arxiv-2004-03206.title: Zipping Segment Trees Thanks: This work was partially funded by the Helmholtz Program “Enery System Design”, Topic 2 “Digitalization and System Technology”.
arxiv-2004-03206.creator: Lukas Barth, Dorothea Wagner
arxiv-2004-03206.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Lukas Barth, Dorothea Wagner. Stabbing queries in sets of intervals are usually answered using segment trees. A dynamic variant of segment trees has been presented by van Kreveld and Overmars [ 14 ] , which uses red-black trees to do rebalancing operations. This paper presents zipping segment trees — dynamic segment trees based on zip trees, which were recently introduced by Tarjan et al.

arxiv-2106-05306.title: DiffCloth: Differentiable Cloth Simulation with Dry Frictional Contact Journal: TOG Volume: 1 1 1 1 DOI: 10.1145/3527660 CCS: Computing methodologies Physical simulation
arxiv-2106-05306.creator: Yifei Li, Tao Du, Kui Wu, Jie Xu, Wojciech Matusik
arxiv-2106-05306.description: Abstract . Cloth simulation has wide applications in computer animation, garment design, and robot-assisted dressing. This work presents a differentiable cloth simulator whose additional gradient information facilitates cloth-related applications. Our differentiable simulator extends a state-of-the-art cloth simulator based on Projective Dynamics (PD) and with dry frictional contact ( Ly et al. 2020 ) .

arxiv-2107-05509.title: Multiview Image-based Hand Geometry Refinement using Differentiable Monte Carlo Ray Tracing
arxiv-2107-05509.creator: Giorgos Karvounas, Nikolaos Kyriazis, Iason Oikonomidis, Aggeliki Tsoli, Antonis A. Argyros
arxiv-2107-05509.description: Abstract The amount and quality of datasets and tools available in the research field of hand pose and shape estimation act as evidence to the significant progress that has been made. However, even the datasets of the highest quality, reported to date, have shortcomings in annotation.

arxiv-2209-10803.title: A unified study for estimation of order restricted location/scale parameters under the generalized Pitman nearness criterion
arxiv-2209-10803.creator: Naresh Garg and Neeraj Misra Department of Mathematics and Statistics Indian Institute of Technology Kanpur Kanpur-208016, Uttar Pradesh, India
arxiv-2209-10803.description: Abstract Abstract We consider component-wise estimation of order restricted location/scale parameters of a general bivariate location/scale distribution under the generalized Pitman nearness criterion (GPN). We develop some general results that, in many situations, are useful in finding improvements over location/scale equivariant estimators.

arxiv-2302-12689.title: GANterfactual-RL: Understanding Reinforcement Learning Agents’ Strategies through Visual Counterfactual Explanations Conference: Proc. of the 22nd International Conference on Autonomous Agents and Multiagent Systems (AAMAS 2023); May 29 – June 2, 2023; London, United Kingdom 561
arxiv-2302-12689.creator: Tobias Huber, Maximilian Demmler, Silvan Mertes, Matthew L. Olson, Elisabeth André
arxiv-2302-12689.description: Abstract . Counterfactual explanations are a common tool to explain artificial intelligence models. For Reinforcement Learning (RL) agents, they answer "Why not?" or "What if?" questions by illustrating what minimal change to a state is needed such that an agent chooses a different action.

arxiv-2306-02925.title: Deep Generalized Green’s Functions
arxiv-2306-02925.creator: Rixi Peng, Juncheng Dong, Jordan Malof, Willie J. Padilla, Vahid Tarokh
arxiv-2306-02925.description: Abstract In this study, we address the challenge of obtaining a Green’s function operator for linear partial differential equations (PDEs). The Green’s function is well-sought after due to its ability to directly map inputs to solutions, bypassing the need for common numerical methods such as finite difference and finite elements methods.

arxiv-2306-15684.title: Understanding (Ir)rational Herding Online
arxiv-2306-15684.creator: Henry K. Dambanemuya, Johannes Wachs, Emőke-Ágnes Horvát
arxiv-2306-15684.description: Abstract Investigations of social influence in collective decision-making have become possible due to recent technologies and platforms that record interactions in far larger groups than could be studied before. Herding and its impact on decision-making are critical areas of practical interest and research study.

arxiv-2405-04080.title: Derisking of subsynchronous torsional oscillations in power systems with conventional and inverter-based generation
arxiv-2405-04080.creator: Nicolas Bonafé, Julian Freytes, Hani Saad
arxiv-2405-04080.description: Abstract This article proposes an application of a derisking methodology of subsynchronous torsional oscillations considering a realistic use case. The main objective is to summarize and draft a synthetic paper clarifying the complete methodology highlighting the main information needed step-by-step.

arxiv-2409-05726.title: Optical Spiking Neurons Enable High-Speed and Energy-Efficient Optical Neural Networks
arxiv-2409-05726.creator: Bo Xu, Zefeng Huang, Yuetong Fang, XinWang, BojunCheng, ShaoliangYu, ZhongruiWang, Renjing Xu
arxiv-2409-05726.description: Abstract Optical neural networks (ONNs) perform extensive computations using photons instead of electrons, resulting in passively energy-efficient and low-latency computing. Among various ONNs, the diffractive optical neural networks (DONNs) particularly excel in energy efficiency, bandwidth, and parallelism, therefore attract considerable attention.

arxiv-2411-06764.title: Multi-Stage Knowledge Integration of Vision-Language Models for Continual Learning
arxiv-2411-06764.creator: Hongsheng Zhang, Zhong Ji ID, Senior Member, IEEE, Jingren Liu, Yanwei Pang ID, Senior Member, IEEE, and Jungong Han ID, Senior Member, IEEE
arxiv-2411-06764.description: Abstract Vision Language Models (VLMs), pre-trained on large-scale image-text datasets, enable zero-shot predictions for unseen data but may underperform on specific unseen tasks. Continual learning (CL) can help VLMs effectively adapt to new data distributions without joint training, but faces challenges of catastrophic forgetting and generalization forgetting.

arxiv-2502-17899.title: Can Large Language Models Identify Implicit Suicidal Ideation? An Empirical Evaluation
arxiv-2502-17899.creator: Tong Li, Shu Yang, Junchao Wu, Jiyao Wei, Lijie Hu, Mengdi Li, Derek F. Wong, Joshua R. Oltmanns, Di Wang
arxiv-2502-17899.description: Abstract * * footnotetext: Equal Contribution † † footnotetext: Corresponding Author Suicide remains a major global mental health challenge, and early intervention hinges on recognizing signs of suicidal ideation. In private conversations, such ideation is often expressed in subtle or conflicted ways, making detection especially difficult.

arxiv-2506-21511.title: Gaussian Invariant Markov Chain Monte Carlo
arxiv-2506-21511.creator: Michalis K. Titsias
arxiv-2506-21511.description: Abstract We develop sampling methods, which consist of Gaussian invariant versions of random walk Metropolis (RWM), Metropolis adjusted Langevin algorithm (MALA) and second order Hessian or Manifold MALA. Unlike standard RWM and MALA we show that Gaussian invariant sampling can lead to ergodic estimators with improved statistical efficiency.

arxiv-2602-07422.title: Secure Code Generation via Online Reinforcement Learning with Vulnerability Reward Model
arxiv-2602-07422.creator: Tianyi Wu, Mingzhe Du, Yue Liu, Chengran Yang, Yue Zhuo, Jiaheng Zhang, See-Kiong Ng
arxiv-2602-07422.description: Abstract Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in software development, yet their tendency to generate insecure code remains a major barrier to real-world deployment. Existing secure code alignment methods often suffer from a functionality–security paradox, improving security at the cost of substantial utility degradation. We propose SecCoderX , an online reinforcement learning framework for functionality-preserving secure code generation.

britannica-1911-haggard-henry-rider.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-haggard-henry-rider.description: Article 'Haggard, Henry Rider' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 12), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. was born at Bradenham Hall, Norfolk, on the 22nd of June 1856. When he was nineteen he went to South Africa as secretary to Sir Henry Bulwer, governor of Natal. At the time of the first annexation of the Transvaal (1877), he was on the staff of the special commissioner, Sir Theophilus Shepstone; and he subsequently became a master of the high court of the Transvaal.

pmc-10658370.description: In the context of the connotative development of higher education, the match between what college graduates have learned and what they have used and its causes has aroused the attention of society. pmc-11324591.title: Exercise leads to sex-specific recovery of behavior and pathological AD markers following adolescent ethanol exposure in the TgF344-AD model
pmc-11324591.creator: Nicole L. Reitz, Polliana T. Nunes, Lisa M. Savage
pmc-11324591.description: IntroductionHuman epidemiological studies suggest that heavy alcohol consumption may lead to earlier onset of Alzheimer’s Disease (AD), especially in individuals with a genetic predisposition for AD. pmc-12471906.description: Technological advancements for the miniaturization of electronic components highlight a critical role of thin and durable stencils in advanced surface mount technology. Here, we report a transparent and fine film stencil consisting of a clear polyimide film and a functional diamond-like carbon coating layer for the fine-pitch surface mount technology process.
